officialSources.observation: Current first-party IGVSB homepage returned 200 and exposed general geodesic, cartographic, geomatics, and mapoteca services; no public parcel viewer or parcel API link was identified in the inspected page.

Local reporting identifies the Municipality of Independencia municipal Catastro office in Santa Teresa del Tuy and describes a municipal cadastral plan covering Santa Teresa and Cartanal, including installation of SIGELIT and gvSIG. This is evidence of the local custodian, not an open data endpoint.

A publicly indexed 2024 municipal cadastral survey drawing names the Alcaldía Socialista Municipio Independencia, Estado Miranda and a Directora de Catastro; it shows a municipal cadastral code layout and survey geometry in the municipality. No raw parcel dataset or public service endpoint was available from the document.
